title: G2-M4 mechanism attribution: A = independent full-path alternative-mesh-family robustness; B = fixed-S2 ring factorial (NOT AUTHORIZED)

stages.M4_0: source lock, this preregistration, zero-state feasibility of an alternative S0 (mesh only, no FEM); evidence outputs/g2_m4_feasibility/run_20261121_172817_429 (FEASIBLE)
stages.M4_A: AUTHORIZED by Issue #44 after this policy is committed: three new two-step numerical paths (homogeneous, soft, stiff) on the alternative mesh family, then ONE consolidated scientific review packet and STOP
stages.M4_B: NOT AUTHORIZED. Requires explicit researcher authorization after the M4.A review; must be preregistered as G2_M4_POLICY_v2 (or an amendment) before any ring-subset solve
stages.M4_C: NOT AUTHORIZED (design decision after a second review gate)

base.originalMaterialChains: outputs/g2_material_trajectories_v1/chain_{soft,stiff}_v1 (every file read must appear in the M3 ledger with the same SHA-256)

materials.role: alternative-family reference path Gamma_H^a; driving K from g2_trajectory_sif_on_mesh (homogeneous pipeline); every state also solves M0 (two-phase solver at ratio 1, identity to H1 under the inherited G2_MATERIAL_POLICY_v1 identityM0 tolerances; bitwise equality of u and EDI recorded as information) and Msoft, Mstiff on Gamma_H^a (frozen-path direct effect within the family)

altFamily.S0builder: g2_join_protected_mesh('ExteriorOptions',exteriorOptions,'MaxT3Elements',40000) - the exact WP2 routine (F1 proved it reproduces famA bitwise with originalFamilyExteriorOptions)
altFamily.sharedWithOriginalFamily: frozen p010 kernel (2788 core T3) and analytic collar (128 T3) by construction, the 15-mm tip guide with Hface 1.5, the physical holes, crack, band radii, BVP anchors; everything else (exterior T3, band interface chords 112 vs 76, plate) is regenerated
altFamily.independenceDisclosure: the near-tip core/collar is identical in both families by policy (it carries the qualified q support); the families differ in exterior and band discretization. The test therefore measures exterior/band-discretization and band-polygon sensitivity of the full paths, not near-tip discretization sensitivity
altFamily.S0record: outputs/g2_m4_alt_family_v1/S0ALT (GEOMETRY_ONLY_candidate.mat + S0ALT.mat record), built once, shared by the three chains by SHA-256

start.parentK: full-precision K of the chain's OWN solve on the alternative S0 (never the original-family K, never rounded)

recurrence: theta = g2_mts_direction(KI_perkN, KII_perkN); t_new = cos(theta) t + sin(theta) n, n = R(+90) t; tip_new = tip + 4 t_new (identical to G2-M3)

mesh.S0audits: join 13/13 (g2_join_protected_mesh), g2_independent_t6_checker 38/38 and g2_protected_tip_checker 24/24 on the SAVED arrays
mesh.stepAudit: g2_kink_admissibility K1-K10 before meshing; g2_kinked_mesh_auditor 34/34 on the SAVED arrays

phase: g2_material_phase_stage (PR #38 phase stage, unchanged): mapper + independent verifier + state-aware negatives on every new mesh, including S0ALT and the homogeneous chain; no labels reused across meshes
sif: unchanged qualified routines and thresholds: g2_material_sif_on_mesh (soft, stiff, M0, and Msoft/Mstiff on Gamma_H^a), g2_trajectory_sif_on_mesh + g2_t6_elasticity (H1); blind bank COD first, five-annulus EDI (6x6 and 4x4), J, matrix-only q, residual/statics/energy/interface gates, K_II sign gate
records: S0ALT record; per chain ROOT (S0 solution records in ROOT_S0/), then per step mesh MAT, PHASE_MAP, SOLUTION(s), REVIEW, STATE (g2_trajectory_record manifests, never overwritten); HOLD on failure; reuse re-verifies forecast, mesh hash and content, 34/34 re-audit, phase re-map and verifier, solution hashes, parent and source hashes without FEM

decomposition.G: (KI_raw^2 + KII_raw^2)/E_m at P = 1 N (EDI 6x6, annulus 0.4-2.6 mm); COD and J secondary
decomposition.withinFamily: R_direct = G_M[Gamma_H]/G_H[Gamma_H]; R_path = G_M[Gamma_M]/G_M[Gamma_H]; R_total = G_M[Gamma_M]/G_H[Gamma_H], each computed with BOTH G values from the same family
decomposition.originalFamily: recomputed exactly as the M3 analysis from PR #38 records and PR #41 chains; must equal the M3 analysis ledger values to 1e-12 relative (regression)
decomposition.S0: R_path = 1 exactly in each family; the soft/stiff chain S0 solve must equal the homogeneous chain's S0 Msoft/Mstiff solve bitwise

uncertainty.ratioPrimary: inherited: U = max(contour spread, |R_4x4 - R|, |R_COD - R|, U_mesh for cross-mesh ratios); resolved iff |R-1| > 2U and COD sign agrees
uncertainty.U_mesh: inherited PR #38 value |G_H1(S2alt)/G_H1(S2) - 1| (read from the PR #38 records; not re-estimated)
uncertainty.pathSeparationWithinFamily: inherited M3 definition: tip separation and signed lateral offset (tip_M - tip_H).n_H with n_H the normal of the family's own homogeneous tangent; U_sep(29.4) = 4 U_dTheta0, U_sep(33.4) = 8 U_dTheta0 + 4 U_dTheta1; conservative variant from |theta_EDI - theta_COD|
uncertainty.S0Kprecision: the original homogeneous S1 was seeded from the six-digit K (amendment A1, 4.41e-6 mm tip offset); the alternative family uses full precision; the A1 offset is reported next to every original-H comparison

lateralSeparation.definition: delta^f(s) = signed lateral offset of Gamma_M^f relative to Gamma_H^f in family f in {o, a}; Delta = delta^a - delta^o; d_H = |tip_H^a - tip_H^o| (cross-family drift of the reference path)
lateralSeparation.STABLE: sign(delta^a) = sign(delta^o) AND |Delta| <= 0.25 |delta^o| (relative) AND |Delta| <= 0.010 mm (absolute) AND |delta^a| > 2 max(d_H, U_sep^a) (distinct from cross-family drift and resolved in family a)
lateralSeparation.MARGINAL: same sign and |delta^a| > 2 U_sep^a, but at least one other STABLE condition fails

ratios.rule: inherited M3 robustness rule applied to R_direct, R_path, R_total at s = 29.4 and 33.4 (R_direct and R_total also at 25.4): ROBUST iff sign(R^a - 1) = sign(R^o - 1) and |R^a - R^o| <= 0.25 |R^o - 1| + 2 U_mesh; SENSITIVE if same sign and larger; NOT_ROBUST if different sign
ratios.conservativeNote: the conservative (about +-3.5 %) rule is reported for both families; under it no ratio was resolved in M3 and no stronger claim is made here

crossFamilyCriteria.steering: local MTS turns compared per state within each family (dTheta_own = theta_M - theta_H at matched parents); global headings compared across families
crossFamilyCriteria.bandAreaAccounting: band polygon areas (76-gon vs 112-gon chords) are recorded per mesh; the cross-family ratio change is NOT attributed to FEM discretization alone; an indicative area-proportional magnitude |R^o - 1| x |A^a/A^o - 1| is reported as a heuristic only, not as a separation
crossFamilyCriteria.verdict: M4.A FULL_PATH_ROBUST iff every material separation at 29.4 and 33.4 is STABLE and every R_path and R_direct classification is ROBUST; PARTIAL if all signs agree but any MARGINAL/SENSITIVE; NOT_ROBUST otherwise; HOLD_FULL_PATH_ROBUSTNESS if any chain fails a gate

stopCodes: HOLD_INTERFACE_APPROACH (not reachable within two steps; reserved)
reviewGates: REVIEW_STOP_A after M4.A: one consolidated packet, no M4.B
REVIEW_STOP_B after a future authorized M4.B
futureM4BIdentityTests: if later authorized: F(empty) bitwise equal to H1 on the frozen S2 mesh; F({1,2,3}) equal to PR #38 S2 Msoft/Mstiff u, K, energy, compliance within the PR #38 identity criteria; new ring-activation mask verifier; legacy verifiers unchanged
forbidden: seeding alternative paths from original-family K
reusing labels, U or K across meshes
onset, toughness, arrest, debonding, CZM, experimental claims
